title: Eliphaz Speaks: The Innocent Do Not Perish

questions.question: Who was the first friend to speak to Job?
questions.explanation: Job 4:1 (ESV): "Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said:"

questions.question: What question did Eliphaz ask about the innocent?
options: Who that was innocent ever perished?
questions.correctAnswer: Who that was innocent ever perished?
questions.explanation: Job 4:7 (ESV): "Remember: who that was innocent ever perished? Or where were the upright cut off?"

questions.question: What do those who plow iniquity reap?
questions.explanation: Job 4:8 (ESV): "As I have seen, those who plow iniquity and sow trouble reap the same."

questions.question: How did Eliphaz describe Job's past actions?
questions.explanation: Job 4:3 (ESV): "Behold, you have instructed many, and you have strengthened the weak hands."

questions.question: What happens to the lions according to Eliphaz?
options: The teeth of the young lions are broken
questions.correctAnswer: The teeth of the young lions are broken
questions.explanation: Job 4:10 (ESV): "The roar of the lion, the voice of the fierce lion, the teeth of the young lions are broken."

questions.question: What experience did Eliphaz recount?
options: A spirit glided past my face
Seeing a vision of the future
questions.correctAnswer: A spirit glided past my face
questions.explanation: Job 4:15 (ESV): "A spirit glided past my face; the hair of my flesh stood up."

questions.question: What question did the voice ask Eliphaz?
options: Can mortal man be in the right before God?
questions.correctAnswer: Can mortal man be in the right before God?
questions.explanation: Job 4:17 (ESV): "Can mortal man be in the right before God? Can a man be pure before his Maker?"

questions.question: What did Eliphaz say happens to those who die without wisdom?
options: They perish forever without any regarding it
questions.correctAnswer: They perish forever without any regarding it
questions.explanation: Job 4:20 (ESV): "By evening they are cut in pieces; they perish forever without any regarding it."

questions.question: How did Eliphaz describe God's trust in His servants?
options: Even in his servants he puts no trust
questions.correctAnswer: Even in his servants he puts no trust
questions.explanation: Job 4:18 (ESV): "Even in his servants he puts no trust, and his angels he charges with error;"

questions.question: How are humans described in contrast to angels/God?
options: Those who dwell in houses of clay
questions.correctAnswer: Those who dwell in houses of clay
questions.explanation: Job 4:19 (ESV): "how much more those who dwell in houses of clay, whose foundation is in the dust..."

questions.question: What physical reaction did Eliphaz have to the spirit?
options: The hair of my flesh stood up
questions.correctAnswer: The hair of my flesh stood up
questions.explanation: Job 4:15 (ESV): "...the hair of my flesh stood up."

questions.question: When did this vision occur to Eliphaz?
options: Amid thoughts from visions of the night
questions.correctAnswer: Amid thoughts from visions of the night
questions.explanation: Job 4:13 (ESV): "Amid thoughts from visions of the night, when deep sleep falls on men,"

questions.question: Like what are humans crushed?
questions.explanation: Job 4:19 (ESV): "...who are crushed like the moth."

questions.question: What happens to their tent-cord?
options: It is plucked up within them
questions.correctAnswer: It is plucked up within them
questions.explanation: Job 4:21 (ESV): "Is not their tent-cord plucked up within them, do they not die, and that without wisdom?"

questions.question: What word was brought to Eliphaz stealthily?
options: My ear received the whisper of it
questions.correctAnswer: My ear received the whisper of it
questions.explanation: Job 4:12 (ESV): "Now a word was brought to me stealthily; my ear received the whisper of it."

key_verse_text: Can mortal man be in the right before God? Can a man be pure before his Maker?
